q.en: Change to passive: They will finish the work.
q.as: কৰ্মবাচ্যলৈ সলাওক: They will finish the work.

options.en: The work will be finished by them.
options.as: The work will be finished by them.

options.en: The work will finished by them.
options.as: The work will finished by them.

options.en: The work is finished by them.
options.as: The work is finished by them.

options.en: The work was finished by them.
options.as: The work was finished by them.

explanation.en: With will the passive is will be plus the past participle.
explanation.as: Will ৰ সৈতে কৰ্মবাচ্য will be আৰু অতীত কৃদন্তৰে হয়।
